name: WebBrowserInstance
label: Web Browser Instance
description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

name: Capture
label: Capture Mode
description: Specify whether to capture the entire web page or only a specific element.

selectOptions.label: Specific Element
selectOptions.description: Capture only a selected UI element.

name: UiElement
label: UI Element
description: Select the UI element on the web page to capture. Only used if 'Specific Element' mode is selected.

name: SaveMode
label: Save Mode
description: Specify whether to save the image into a file or store it in the clipboard.

selectOptions.label: Clipboard
selectOptions.description: Save the image to the clipboard.

selectOptions.label: File
selectOptions.description: Save the image to a file.

name: ImageFile
label: Image File Path
description: Set the full path for the file to save the image capture.

name: FileFormat
label: Image Format
description: Choose the format in which the image will be saved.
